# Lookout Mountain Mahjong / Mountain Mahjong

## Services
- Mahjong 101: beginner American mahjong — tiles, NMJL card, rules, scoring, first full game (2–3 hours, 4–8 players)
- Mahjong 102: advanced strategy, Siamese and Patio play, tournament skills
- Private events & travel: "Let us travel to you" — corporate, sororities, clubs, Martha's Vineyard, The Greenbrier
- TML ambassador referral code: LOOKOUTMOUNTAIN (@themahjongline)
